findings.evidence: Projective/Acyclic.lean:45-47 and :60-62 both contain `letI : Subsingleton (Quiver.Path i i) := h.subsingleton_path_self i; letI : Unique (Quiver.Path i i) := uniqueOfSubsingleton Quiver.Path.nil; rw [..., Nat.card_unique]`, identical to the private helper's body.
findings.fix: Promote this to a single public lemma (e.g. `Nat.card_path_self_of_isAcyclic` or a `Unique (Path a a)` instance) beside `Quiver.IsAcyclic.subsingleton_path_self` in RepresentationTheory/Quiver/Acyclic/Basic.lean, and have both the new file and Projective/Acyclic.lean use it instead of re-deriving the `Unique` instance.
findings.issue: Private `card_path_self_of_isAcyclic` (Nat.card (Path a a) = 1 for acyclic quivers) reproduces the `Subsingleton`/`uniqueOfSubsingleton Path.nil`/`Nat.card_unique` incantation already inlined twice in Projective/Acyclic.lean (finrank_end_indecProjRep_of_isAcyclic:45-47 and titsForm_dimVector_indecProjRep_of_isAcyclic:60-62). Three copies of the same fact, none shared.

summary: The categorical brick/idempotent criteria are new (Mathlib has only indecomposable_of_simple) and reuse finrank_eq_one_iff_of_nonzero' correctly. One near-clone: the acyclic 'exactly one closed path' computation is a private helper that duplicates an inline pattern already appearing twice in Projective/Acyclic.lean.
